text:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY rollout queued by @release-manager for 15:30 UTC. config_id=conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2

deploy-bot: changeset summary:
- per-tenant concurrent_limit: 40 -> 30 (soft cap)
- per-tenant rate_limit: 120r/s -> 90r/s (burst 150)
- request_timeout: 60s -> 45s
- batch_window_ms: 8 -> 5 (tighten batching for p50)
- routing: add tenant affinity for high-qps customers (sticky hashing)

marta: taking point on canary. plan to route 10% of production traffic for 20m -> observe.
jon: noted. add p95 latency + queue_length + kvcache_miss to canary dashboard. also watch model_fallback_rate.
sam: ops: if we see p95 +20% or errors >0.5% roll back immediately. agree on thresholds?
lina: threshold: p95 latency delta > 15% OR error_rate > 0.4% for 5m window = auto rollback signal. also watch GPU_utilization and inflight_batches.
ops-oncall: I'll be online for the canary. prepping quick rollback cmd in runbook.
release-manager: tagging release notes: "Reduce per-tenant concurrency and tighten batch window to lower tail latency and steady-state cost; add tenant affinity routing." will add short why and risk section.

marta: executing canary now: /deploy config-canary start conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2 --percent 10 --duration 20m
deploy-bot: Canary started: conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2 -> 10% traffic. watch id: canary-1768904321. Alerts hooked to #incidents and paging policy.

sam: quick check — does sticky hashing affect cross-region routing? could increase tail for some geo.
lina: sticky is per-region fallback only, we'll keep default geo fallback. added sticky_exclusions for low-volume tenants.
jon: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-1768904321 (p50/p95/error/queue/kvcache)
ops-oncall: seeing a small bump in queue_length on one host group (+12%). p95 steady so far.
marta: good. also seeing batch_window drop reduced average tokens/sec per-batch as expected.

deploy-bot: Canary halfway (10m): p50 -1ms, p95 +3%, error_rate 0.09% (baseline 0.07%), queue_length +8%

sam: within thresholds. continue.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: 20m elapsed. metrics stable. promoting to 40% for 30m.
release-manager: tagging release-channel note: rollout -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% (staged). rollout window 15:30-16:45 UTC.

jon: small ask — add a temporary metric to alert on batch_retries (if batching tightens and causes OOMs). can we emit batch_queue_retries?
lina: done, new metric emitted in canary namespace.

deploy-bot: Promotion successful: 40% active. now monitoring 30m.

ops-oncall: seeing one host with batch_retries spike x3 but it's localized, not service-wide. investigating.
marta: If it persists >5m we roll back that host group and pin config to previous: /deploy config-pin conf-id conf-2026-03-14-tenant-softcap-v1 --scope hostgroup=hg-east-3

ops-oncall: spike resolved after drain and restart on host hg-east-3. no rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% scheduled in 15m if metrics remain green.
release-manager: final checklist before 100%: update release notes, post changelog in #general, update docs on per-tenant limits (internal + public).

sam: rollback plan summary (for runbook):
1) issue: serious p95 or error thresholds breached.
2) immediate command: /deploy config-rollback conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2 --to conf-2026-03-14-tenant-softcap-v1
3) if partial host issue: /deploy config-pin conf-2026-03-14-tenant-softcap-v1 --scope hostgroup=<id>
4) postmortem owner: service-owner + @release-manager

lina: added canary notes to runbook and wired alerts:
- alert: canary_p95_delta > 15% for 5m -> page ops-oncall
- alert: error_rate > 0.4% for 5m -> page ops-oncall + oncall-sre
- alert: batch_retries_rate > 2x baseline for 5m -> page eng-runtime

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% done. conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2 active.

marta: quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
jon: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup: good job.

release-manager: leaving a short note for docs team: "Config-only: tenant caps reduced to protect tail latency; expect some tenants to hit limits earlier — contact infra if you need exemptions."

deploy-bot: Audit log updated: https://console.redwood.internal/audit/configs/conf-2026-03-21-tenant-softcap-v2

marta: Done. I'm archiving canary dashboard and adding the results to the release artifact (attach perf graphs).

ops-oncall: closing loop — no incidents, monitoring in passive mode for 24h.

release-manager: thanks team. will add a small entry to the weekly release notes and mark as config-only.

lina: follow-up item: schedule a 1h post-rollout review tomorrow to check cost impact after 24h traffic. assigning to @lina and @jon.

marta: ack.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by release-manager.
